"Deadeye" '''Grath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal who was imprisoned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], Grath was freed from imprisonment, and started selling weapon and gear modifications to the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Deadeye" Grath appears as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
